version.changelog:
Initial release of QiyueAstro Lenormand Drawer.

- Draw Lenormand cards in multiple spreads: single card, three-card, relationship, decision, nine-card grid, and more.
- Browse the full 36-card Lenormand deck with meanings and keywords in English or Chinese.
- No API key, authentication, or signup required.
- All card data served directly from the QiyueAstro public API.
- Includes clear formatting and strict rules for displaying card images, names, positions, meanings, and keywords.

llm.summary: This Lenormand card skill is mostly coherent, but it can activate for broad personal advice and send the user’s question to an external API without a clear consent step.

dimensions.detail: Network access to QiyueAstro is expected for the skill, but broad activation plus automatic question forwarding creates an under-scoped privacy concern for potentially sensitive personal text.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only markdown skill documentation and a README, with no executable installer, package scripts, or privileged setup instructions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Activation includes generic love, relationship, and decision guidance, so ordinary personal-advice prompts could be routed into this card-reading workflow even when the user did not explicitly ask for Lenormand cards.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact describes stateless unauthenticated GET requests and shows no persistence, credential storage, background workers, local file indexing, or privilege escalation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill’s stated purpose is to draw and browse Lenormand cards through QiyueAstro, which matches its API instructions; the notable sensitive behavior is forwarding user questions as API query parameters when included in a reading request.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing if users may ask sensitive relationship, health, or life-decision questions. The skill should ideally activate only on explicit Lenormand/card-reading requests or ask before sending free-form questions to QiyueAstro.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: The artifact supports this concern: the activation list includes broad relationship and decision guidance beyond explicit Lenormand or card-reading intent.
[SQP-2] expected: Passing a question to the draw API is purpose-aligned for contextual readings, but the artifact instructs automatic forwarding and does not require a user-facing privacy notice or confirmation first.
